title: This $500K racehorse loses money every single month
description: A racehorse that costs half a million dollars and loses money almost every month it's owned. The real payoff isn't the racing — it's what a champion is worth once it retires to stud.

scenes.narration: This racehorse cost half a million dollars. It loses money every month.
scenes.imagePrompt: A gleaming thoroughbred racehorse with a glossy dark bay coat and hand-plaited mane standing in profile inside a sunlit hand-laid brick stable yard, a dark oiled-timber stable roof overhang in shadow filling the top third, no visible people

scenes.narration: Feed, training, stabling, veterinary care and a private groom all run every single month regardless of results.
scenes.imagePrompt: Interior of an immaculate private stable aisle with hand-turned oak stall doors and polished brass fittings, fresh straw bedding in bright daylight from a high window, dark exposed oak roof beams in shadow above, no people

scenes.narration: Monthly upkeep alone runs about fifteen thousand dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close view of folded wool stable blankets and a hand-stitched leather halter with brass buckles laid across a glossy oak stall door in bright daylight, dark barn roof structure in shadow above, no people, no visible text

scenes.narration: Fewer than one in ten racehorses ever earns back its purchase price.
scenes.imagePrompt: A thoroughbred racehorse with a glossy coat being led along a sunlit raked-gravel path beside white-painted timber paddock rails, seen from behind so no handler's face is visible, dark treeline in shadow filling the top third

scenes.narration: Most owners never expect the horse's winnings alone to cover the stable bills.
scenes.imagePrompt: Private manicured-turf training gallop track at a stud farm, white post-and-rail fencing stretching into bright morning daylight, dark distant treeline in shadow above, empty track, no people

scenes.narration: A single stud fee for a champion can reach three hundred thousand dollars.
scenes.imagePrompt: Extreme close-up of an elegant hand-cut limestone wall with a single arched window and a wrought-iron lantern beside it, the entrance and any signage entirely out of frame, bright daylight, dark slate roof eaves in shadow filling the top third, no people, no text

scenes.narration: The real return isn't the racing. It's what a champion earns at stud afterward.
scenes.imagePrompt: A glossy chestnut mare and foal grazing together in a sunlit white-rail paddock, manicured green pasture, dark distant tree line in shadow above, no people

scenes.narration: So the horse was never really the investment. The bloodline is. Follow for more of these.
scenes.imagePrompt: A thoroughbred racehorse with a glossy dark coat standing alone in a sunlit paddock beside white-painted timber rails, dark oiled-timber stable roofline in shadow filling the top third of the frame, no people
